title: Proposal ledger
description: Proposed settings move into the current column when accepted, with explicit applied and kept states.
useCase: Review an agent's field edits individually and apply only undecided changes.
interaction: Accept or reject each field, undo a decision, or apply the remaining changes.
reducedMotion: Finite transitions become immediate under reduced motion and keyboard input. Host pause disables controls; any owned drag is cancelled.
limitations: Three local release settings; acceptance only updates this example's in-memory state. Wire confirmed decisions to application data in an integration.
look: Cool grey page with a white rounded three-row table: muted values, arrows to chip-styled proposals, cross and green check buttons, dark green footer button.
motion: Accepting a row slides its proposed chip left into the current column (260 ms ease-out) while the old value fades and the row tints green; rejecting fades the proposal right.
adapt: All motion is CSS keyed on each `change` row's `data-state`: `.new` shifts `translateX(-107px)` on accept while `.old` and `.direction` fade, over 260 ms `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`. Replace `CHANGES` with real proposed edits and persist `decisions` set by `decide`.
